\section[(dialogue)]{Describing words and time — a first pass}

\label{lesson:JA-R71-first-pass-describing-words-and-time}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a nephew and a niece.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a minute, summer, winter, always, still
  \item after, before; in front, above, inside, left
  \item near, far, a town, a road, a shop
  \item underground, a park, a country, clothes, shoes
  \item a hat, socks, glasses, thirty, a thousand
  \item ten thousand, twelve, an aubergine, a song, a branch
  \item a thread, a needle, a comb, a string, a rope
  \item luggage, a ship, a sound, a colour, a shape
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A minute? (\emph{fun}.) Summer? (\emph{natsu}.) Winter? (\emph{fuyu}.) Always? (\emph{itsumo}.) Still? (\emph{mada}.) After? (\emph{ato}.) Before; in front? (\emph{mae}.) Above? (\emph{ue}.) Inside? (\emph{naka}.) Left? (\emph{hidari}.) Near? (\emph{chikai}.) Far? (\emph{tooi}.) A town? (\emph{machi}.) A road? (\emph{michi}.) A shop? (\emph{mise}.) Underground? (\emph{chika}.) A park? (\emph{kouen}.) A country? (\emph{kuni}.) Clothes? (\emph{fuku}.) Shoes? (\emph{kutsu}.) A hat? (\emph{boushi}.) Socks? (\emph{kutsushita}.) Glasses? (\emph{megane}.) Thirty? (\emph{sanjuu}.) A thousand? (\emph{sen}.) Ten thousand? (\emph{man}.) Twelve? (\emph{juuni}.) An aubergine? (\emph{nasu}.) A song? (\emph{uta}.) A branch? (\emph{eda}.) A thread? (\emph{ito}.) A needle? (\emph{hari}.) A comb? (\emph{kushi}.) A string? (\emph{himo}.) A rope? (\emph{tsuna}.) Luggage? (\emph{nimotsu}.) A ship? (\emph{fune}.) A sound? (\emph{oto}.) A colour? (\emph{iro}.) A shape? (\emph{katachi}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Places, clothes and more — a second pass}

\label{lesson:JA-R71-second-pass-places-clothes-and-more}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a dream and a festival.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a dream, a festival, west, east, south
  \item powder, sesame, a sea urchin, a sardine, a flavour
  \item a carp, a cicada, a dragonfly, a potato, burdock root
  \item a basket, a spinning top, a raft, a flute, a drum
  \item a hand fan, a folding fan, charcoal; a corner, a well, a beach
  \item a hill, a valley, the countryside, a harbour, the setting sun
  \item a rainbow, thunder, frost, ice, the summer holidays
  \item a rice cake, natto, a fish-paste tube, a chick, a wing; a feather
  \item a horn, a hole, a rice plant, a nephew, a niece
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A dream? (\emph{yume}.) A festival? (\emph{matsuri}.) West? (\emph{nishi}.) East? (\emph{higashi}.) South? (\emph{minami}.) Powder? (\emph{kona}.) Sesame? (\emph{goma}.) A sea urchin? (\emph{uni}.) A sardine? (\emph{iwashi}.) A flavour? (\emph{aji}.) A carp? (\emph{koi}.) A cicada? (\emph{semi}.) A dragonfly? (\emph{tonbo}.) A potato? (\emph{imo}.) Burdock root? (\emph{gobou}.) A basket? (\emph{kago}.) A spinning top? (\emph{koma}.) A raft? (\emph{ikada}.) A flute? (\emph{fue}.) A drum? (\emph{taiko}.) A hand fan? (\emph{uchiwa}.) A folding fan? (\emph{sensu}.) Charcoal; a corner? (\emph{sumi}.) A well? (\emph{ido}.) A beach? (\emph{hama}.) A hill? (\emph{oka}.) A valley? (\emph{tani}.) The countryside? (\emph{inaka}.) A harbour? (\emph{minato}.) The setting sun? (\emph{yuuhi}.) A rainbow? (\emph{niji}.) Thunder? (\emph{kaminari}.) Frost? (\emph{shimo}.) Ice? (\emph{koori}.) The summer holidays? (\emph{natsuyasumi}.) A rice cake? (\emph{mochi}.) Natto? (\emph{nattou}.) A fish-paste tube? (\emph{chikuwa}.) A chick? (\emph{hiyoko}.) A wing; a feather? (\emph{hane}.) A horn? (\emph{tsuno}.) A hole? (\emph{ana}.) A rice plant? (\emph{ine}.) A nephew? (\emph{oi}.) A niece? (\emph{mei}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
